notes: Fixed a real performance regression from v5.6.199: the Overview tab's 'Needs Attention' card was eagerly rendering a DOM row (with inline event handlers) for EVERY system with any issue -- on a real fleet this ran to ~900+ extra nodes rebuilt on every single Overview visit, even though most stayed inside a collapsed <details>. A large DOM makes the whole page feel sluggish, not just that card. Capped to 50 systems; the full ranked list already exists properly in every deliverable's 'Systems Ranked by Issue Severity' table.
